legend: The lamina propria component is composed of spindle cells and the deeper aspects are vasoformative.
Nuclear expression of ERG helps confirm endothelial differentiation.
A well-differentiated angiosarcoma infiltrating hepatic parenchyma. Note the irregular vascular channels lined by endothelial cells with hyperchromatic nuclei showing a hobnail appearance.
source: Dr Jason L Hornick, Brigham & Women's Hospital, 75 Francis Street, Boston, MA 02115

legend: A poorly differentiated angiosarcoma showing marked nuclear atypia. The tumour infiltrates hepatic parenchyma and forms micropapillary structures.
source: Dr Jason L Hornick, Brigham & Women's Hospital, 75 Francis Street, Boston, MA 02115

legend: The tumour cells surround hepatic cords and form solid sheets of spindle cells.
source: Dr Jason L Hornick, Brigham & Women's Hospital, 75 Francis Street, Boston, MA 02115

legend: Small intestinal angiosarcoma contains irregularly shaped vascular lumina lined by highly atypical endothelial cells with mitotic activity.
